# Variable-font decoder fixture

`inter-latin-variable.woff2` is the Latin, normal-style variable Inter font from `@fontsource-variable/inter` 5.3.0 (`files/inter-latin-standard-normal.woff2`). It declares `opsz` 14–32 (default 14) and `wght` 100–900 (default 400). The OFL 1.1 license and copyright notice are in `OFL.txt`.
